c.description:
CHARACTER HOUSE ON WEST SIDE OF VANCOUVER

-Situated in a quiet neighborhood with city and mountain view
-Unsurpassed privacy as completely shielded by mature trees in front yard

IDEAL FOR FAMILIES AND WORKING PROFESSIONALS

-Nearby public schools: Carnarvon, Trafalgar and Jules Quesnel Elementary, Lord Byng and Point Grey Secondary
-Nearby private schools: St George's, West Point Grey and Crofton House
-Walking distance to public transit on King Edward, W 16th St and Macdonald St
-Close to restaurants, banks, medical/dental clinics, grocery stores on Dunbar, W Broadway and Kerrisdale
-5 min drive to UBC
-5 min drive to Jericho/Kitsilano beaches
-5 min drive to Kerrisdale
-10 min drive to Downtown Vancouver
-20 min drive to Richmond and YVR


HOUSE DETAILS

-Well lit with high ceiling
-Spacious open concept living room, dining room and kitchen to welcome your guests
-Fireplace in the living room
-Venetian blinds on all windows
-Hardwood and tile on main floor
-Kitchen: granite countertop; pantry; lots of cabinet space; energy efficient stainless-steel appliances - Miele gas cooktop with range hood; Bosche oven; dishwasher and fridge; floor to ceiling glass sliding door onto back deck
-Bedrooms on main floor: 2 well sized rooms on opposite sides of the house for extra privacy
-Master Bedroom on top floor: carpeted; unobstructed panoramic view of city and mountain; 3 full closets with mirror bi-fold doors; large en suite bathroom with a shower and a Jacuzzi bathtub
-West facing tiered garden, a true gardener's paradise: spacious wood deck; storage shed; 3 planter boxes

LOOKING FOR:

-Quiet professionals
-Non smokers
-Long term tenants: 1 year lease minimum


AVAILABLE:
-NOV 15, 2026
-$4,850 per month
